# MCPserver.in — Model Context Protocol Knowledge Base for AI Agents

## About
MCPserver.in is an MCP-focused knowledge hub and server directory for developers and teams building AI-agent integrations. It covers Model Context Protocol architecture, JSON-RPC 2.0, tools, resources, prompts, transports, authentication, authorization, security, deployment, observability, and India-specific compliance considerations.

## Core Entities
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- MCP Server

- Authentication and authorization
- DPDP Act 2023
- RBI guidance where applicable to regulated workflows

## Core Ontology
- [What is MCP?](https://mcpserver.in/what-is-mcp/): Protocol architecture, JSON-RPC 2.0, and transports.
- [MCP Server](https://mcpserver.in/mcp-server/): Tools, resources, prompts, and client-server boundaries.
- [MCP Protocol](https://mcpserver.in/mcp-protocol/): Message lifecycle and transport options.
- [MCP Hosting](https://mcpserver.in/mcp-hosting/): Deployment, observability, security, and regional hosting considerations.
- [MCP Security](https://mcpserver.in/mcp-security/): Authentication, authorization, credential handling, and compliance.

## India-Specific Authority
- [DPDP Compliance for MCP](https://mcpserver.in/learn/dpdp-compliance-guide/): Data minimization, consent, retention, and audit logging.
- [India Services](https://mcpserver.in/learn/india-services/): India-first routing and data-handling considerations.
- [India MCP Statistics](https://mcpserver.in/data/mcp-india-stats-2026.csv): Illustrative architecture-planning data, not measured production telemetry.

## Entity Relationships
- MCPserver.in publishes and curates educational content about the Model Context Protocol.
- MCP servers expose tools, resources, and prompts to compatible MCP clients.
- MCP uses JSON-RPC 2.0 message structures and supported transport mechanisms.
- India-focused compliance material discusses DPDP requirements and RBI considerations where applicable.
